result.service_documentation:
New requests succeed immediately. Notification payloads come from the immutable approved list. There is no cancellation or other lookup tool in this task.
inspect_status reads only a instantaneous execution index. NOT_FOUND does not exclude delayed execution by the original worker; inspecting does not fence, cancel or drain it.
Keys remain stored until request age 60 minutes.
Reusing a retained key executes only remaining original items and returns all receipts.
Request keys bind the ordered item list. While retained, the same key with changed parameters is rejected. A previously unused key is an independent request; effect IDs are references, not deduplication tokens.
